verdict.rationale: Stable has a dedicated webhooks doc page saying you can configure webhook endpoints in the Stable Dashboard to be notified about important account events, which covers the core of the story. Configuration is dashboard-only, and the docs suggest polling GET /v1/locations/{id} for location transitions, which hints that event coverage may be incomplete. missing for 10: documented event-type catalog, signature/verification and retry details, API-based (programmatic) webhook subscription management, independent or hands-on corroboration.
